intro.text: A Surgebinder in the time of Nohadon who had not bonded an honorspren.

items.text: Alakavish brought the world to war before a Desolation, and his powers drew the common people to him. Eleven years into the Desolation some blamed him for how much damage it did, but Nohadon saw him as a symptom of a deeper sickness: humanity torn by war and squabbling.
